entities.name: Methyl ester substrate
observations: The methyl ester converts to the corresponding carboxylic acid while the heteroaromatic core and aryl chlorides remain unchanged.

entities.name: Carboxylic acid product
observations: Product is consistent with ester hydrolysis/saponification of the methyl ester substrate.

entities.name: Ester saponification
observations: Transformation replaces the acyl C–O–Me bond with acyl C–O–H, producing a carboxylic acid.
An exact close ORD record, ord-7099ac378ca745cba98cb7e707d3e8df, supports the transformation.

entities.name: LiOH aqueous dioxolane
observations: Reported reagent system is lithium hydroxide in water with 1,3-dioxolane as solvent/co-solvent.
Acidification during aqueous/protic workup is expected to furnish the isolated carboxylic acid.
Time, temperature, and isolated yield are not established by the retrieved record.
